title: Exchange rates
description: Daily TCMB and ECB rates fetched by the worker, with manual overrides. Orders and journal entries freeze the rate of their day.
override_description: A manual rate wins over TCMB and ECB for that day and pair. Removing it brings the fetched value back.
priority_note: Order: manual > TCMB > ECB. A day without rates uses the previous day.
